headline: Client Relations and Inside Sales Associate
summary: Client relations and inside sales associate with five years at a BPO supporting a US home-services company. I started in customer service handling complaints, and now I also call leads, pitch service plans and keep every account in Salesforce and HubSpot. I work remotely from Dinagat Islands.

projects.name: Win-back calling campaign
bullets: Called 1,200 cancelled customers over three months with a new service offer.
Won back about 14% of them, the account's best result that year.

projects.name: CRM clean-up
projects.description: Merged duplicate contacts and fixed missing fields for 20,000 customer records in Salesforce, so sales and service teams saw the same history.

experience.title: Client Relations and Inside Sales Associate
bullets: Handle service calls and complaints from existing customers and keep their records current.
Call leads from web forms and cold lists and pitch maintenance plans, averaging 25 sales a month.
Log every call and follow-up in Salesforce and HubSpot for the sales and service teams.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Answered inbound calls about bookings, bills and service complaints.
Resolved most concerns on the first call and escalated the rest with full notes.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing
